dialogue.en: You'll find many rare Pokemon here — in the grass, by the lake, and in the mountains!
Be careful in the dense forest to the southeast!
I've been fishing in this lake for years!
Sometimes rare water Pokemon appear in the deep water.
The mountain area is home to rock and ground type Pokemon.
I once saw a Larvitar hiding among the boulders!
This forest is one of the densest in Numeria.
Bug and grass Pokemon thrive here.
I'm studying the unique ecosystem of this sandy area.
Ground type Pokemon have adapted perfectly here.
The Safari Zone is perfect for training!
Let me see how strong your team is!
The bugs in this forest are incredible!
